How do I reset my password?
On the sign-in screen tap \"Forgot password?\", choose SMS or email, enter the 6-digit code and set a new password.
Can I see more than one child in the app?
Yes. Linked students appear on your profile — tap a student to switch between them.
My fee payment isn\'t showing as paid
Payments are marked paid after the accounts office verifies your proof. This can take up to 2 working days.
Attendance is marked wrong — what should I do?
Open the attendance screen and raise a concern, or contact your class teacher through the app.
Can I reply to a voice message?
Yes. Open the message and tap reply to send a text or voice note back to faculty.
How do I turn on fingerprint sign-in?
Go to Settings and turn on Fingerprint / Face unlock to sign in without a password.
